rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice when two things match in degree or extent, as in being equally far.

example.english: The two hotels are equally far from the airport.
example.traditional: 兩間酒店離機場一樣咁遠。
example.jyutping: loeng5 gaan1 zau2 dim3 lei4 gei1 coeng4 jat1 joeng6 gam2 jyun5

rows.note: Use this when equal means distributing amounts or shares evenly.

example.english: They shared this money equally among three people.
example.traditional: 呢筆錢平均分畀三個人。
example.jyutping: ni1 bat1 cin2 ping4 gwan1 fan1 bei2 saam1 go3 jan4

rows.note: Use this when equally means treating people impartially rather than merely giving them equal quantities.

example.english: The manager treated both employees equally and fairly.
example.traditional: 個經理公平咁對待兩個員工。
example.jyutping: go3 ging1 lei5 gung1 ping4 gam2 deoi3 doi6 loeng5 go3 jyun4 gung1
